_comment: P4.D209 / v4 bug 159 (`186eb09cb`) — the RIFF chunk walk behind `isLosslessWebP`. A lossless WebP (a VP8L chunk) is worth re-encoding to lossy at quality 85 once it passes the 512 KiB floor; a lossy one never is. Everything here is hand-built so each arm of the walk has a case of its own: the fourcc verdicts, the extended container that hides the verdict behind other chunks, RIFF's odd-size pad byte, the over-length guard, and every shape that is not a WebP at all. Byte-for-byte the same buffers reach v4's real function and the Rust port, and the verdicts are compared exactly.

cases.name: vp8l_first
cases.why: the plain lossless shape: VP8L is the first chunk

cases.name: vp8x_iccp_alph_vp8l
cases.why: an extended file hiding VP8L behind VP8X/ICCP/ALPH — the reason the WHOLE chunk list is walked instead of only the first fourcc, and the ALPH payload is odd so the RIFF pad byte is on the path

cases.name: vp8_lossy
cases.why: a lossy WebP: `VP8 ` ends the walk with false, it is never re-encoded

cases.name: vp8x_then_vp8_lossy
cases.why: the extended lossy shape — VP8X must not be mistaken for a verdict

cases.name: png
cases.why: a PNG is not a RIFF container at all

cases.name: too_short
cases.why: twelve bytes — under the 16-byte floor, so the walk never starts

cases.name: riff_but_not_webp
cases.why: a RIFF container that is not a WebP

cases.name: truncated_mid_chunk
cases.why: cut inside the first chunk header — `offset + 8 <= len` ends the walk

cases.name: size_past_end
cases.why: a chunk whose declared length overruns the buffer: malformed, so false rather than a guess

cases.name: size_max_u32
cases.why: the same at u32::MAX — the arm that would wrap a Rust usize cursor back into the buffer if the addition were not saturating (JS doubles cannot)

cases.name: odd_chunk_then_vp8l
cases.why: an odd-length chunk followed by VP8L: only the `size % 2` pad byte keeps the cursor on the next fourcc

cases.name: odd_chunk_missing_pad
cases.why: the same bytes with the pad byte ABSENT — the walk lands mid-fourcc and must terminate false rather than find VP8L by luck

cases.name: vp8l_after_two_extras
cases.why: VP8L third, after a one-byte payload of its own (odd, padded)

cases.name: zero_length_chunk_then_vp8l
cases.why: a zero-length chunk advances the cursor by exactly eight
